english.note: Use this when emphasizing the venue or facility hosting a sports or spectacular event rather than its arena layout.
Use this for a purpose-built venue or building used for activities, rather than for a prison, military installation, or laboratory in general.

examples.english: This arena hosts major competitions every year.
examples.traditional: 呢個場館每年都會舉辦大型比賽。

examples.english: This purpose-built facility hosts lots of major events every year.
examples.traditional: 呢個場館每年都搞好多大型活動。
